about.title: Design. Build. Maintain.

We are not just about creating landscapes, we're about crafting experiences. From simple backyard updates to full-service custom landscape architecture, we can assist with design, installation, and maintenance.

As a design-build-maintain firm, we create stunning outdoor spaces transforming your vision from concept to reality. We employ a client-centric design philosophy focused on making your outdoor spaces somewhere you want to create memories for years to come.

faqs.q: Is artificial turf good for Houston?
faqs.a: Artificial turf can work very well in Houston, particularly in high-traffic, shaded, pet-use, and difficult-to-maintain areas. Proper drainage, product selection, and installation are especially important in Houston's climate.
Yes, although considerably less than natural grass. Turf may require periodic rinsing, debris removal, brushing, infill maintenance, and additional cleaning in pet areas.
Yes. Pet-specific turf systems can be designed for durability, drainage, and easier cleaning.

faqs.q: Can weeds grow through artificial turf?
faqs.a: Proper preparation dramatically reduces weed growth, although occasional weeds may develop around edges or from organic material collecting on the surface.

faqs.q: Can artificial turf be installed over an existing lawn?
faqs.a: A professional installation normally requires removal and proper preparation of the existing surface rather than simply placing synthetic turf over living grass.

faqs.q: Will artificial turf solve my drainage problem?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Turf can allow water to drain through its surface, but existing grading or drainage problems may still need to be corrected.

faqs.q: Can artificial turf be combined with landscape beds?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Some of the best-looking installations combine synthetic lawn with natural planting, trees, hardscape, and other landscape elements.
Plant Health Care, or PHC, is a focused approach to assessing and caring for the health of your landscape. Recommendations depend on the plants, symptoms and growing conditions on your property.

faqs.q: Is every brown patch in my lawn a disease?
faqs.a: No. Similar symptoms can have different causes. An evaluation helps determine whether disease, watering, pests or another condition may be involved.

faqs.q: How is plant health care different from root zone fertilization?
faqs.a: Root zone fertilization addresses nutrient needs around the roots of trees and shrubs. Plant health care considers a broader range of concerns, including pests, disease and site conditions. Fertilization may be part of a recommendation when appropriate.

faqs.q: How much does a fall installation cost?
faqs.a: Custom installations start at $500. Final pricing depends on the size of the entrance, the amount and type of seasonal material selected and the overall complexity of the design.

faqs.q: Is removal of a fall display included?
faqs.a: Post-season removal after Thanksgiving is included when specified in your approved installation package.
